overview: This is a complaint filed by Efficient Power Conversion Corporation (EPC) with the U.S. International Trade Commission under Section 337, dated May 26, 2023. EPC alleges that Innoscience (a Chinese manufacturer with U.S. subsidiaries) unlawfully imports and sells semiconductor devices infringing four EPC patents relating to enhancement-mode Gallium Nitride (GaN) transistors and high-electron-mobility transistors (HEMTs). EPC seeks a limited exclusion order, cease and desist orders, and bond to prevent importation of the accused products.

points.point: Complainant Efficient Power Conversion Corporation (EPC) is a Delaware corporation headquartered in El Segundo, California, with additional offices in Aliso Viejo and San Jose, California, engaged in research and development, design, manufacturing, marketing, and sales of GaN semiconductor devices.
points.quote: Complainant EPC is a Delaware corporation with its headquarters and principal place of business located at 909 N. Pacific Coast Highway, Suite 230, El Segundo, CA 90245.

points.point: Respondents are Innoscience (Zhuhai) Technology Company, Ltd., headquartered in Zhuhai, Guangdong, China; Innoscience, Inc., a Delaware corporation affiliate; and Innoscience America, Inc., a California subsidiary at 5451 Great America Pkwy, Santa Clara, California.
points.quote: Innoscience (Zhuhai) Technology Company, Ltd. has its principal place of business and headquarters at No. 39, Jinyuan 2nd Road, High-Tech Zone, Zhuhai, Guangdong, 519099 China.

points.point: Alexander Lidow is EPC's Chief Executive Officer with over forty years of semiconductor industry experience, including a career at International Rectifier where he was instrumental in inventing HEXFET power MOSFETs, and is a prolific GaN patent inventor and 2019 IEEE Hall of Fame inductee.
points.quote: Alexander Lidow, the Chief Executive Officer of EPC, has over forty years of experience in the semiconductor industry.

points.point: GaN semiconductor technology provides higher efficiency, smaller size, and lower cost compared to silicon-based MOSFET devices, with superior crystalline qualities enabling superior conductivity and faster transistor switching speeds than silicon.
points.quote: GaN exhibits superior crystalline qualities and allows for superior conductivity and faster transistor switching speeds than silicon.

points.point: Enhancement-mode GaN FETs are normally in the 'off' state and require application of voltage to switch to the 'on' state, preventing short circuits and providing better controllability than depletion-mode GaN FETs introduced in 2004 which required active voltage application to turn off.
points.quote: EPC's eGaN® FETs are a vast improvement over depletion-mode GaN FETs because they are normally "off" and require the application of voltage (i.e., power) to switch to the "on"-state.

points.point: GaN-on-Si technology allows GaN FETs to be formed on inexpensive silicon-based substrates and manufactured using existing retrofitted MOSFET manufacturing facilities, avoiding significant new investment costs.
points.quote: GaN FETs are formed on inexpensive silicon-based substrates and can be made using existing (retrofitted) MOSFET manufacturing facilities, thereby avoiding significant new investment costs.

points.point: U.S. Patent No. 8,350,294 (the '294 Patent), issued January 8, 2013, expiring August 9, 2030, entitled 'Compensated Gate MISFET and Method for Fabricating the Same,' with independent claims 1-4 and dependent claims, of which EPC asserts claims 1, 2, and 3 are infringed.
points.quote: On January 8, 2013, the United States Patent and Trademark Office ("USPTO") issued the '294 Patent, entitled Compensated Gate MISFET and Method for Fabricating the Same.

points.point: U.S. Patent No. 8,404,508 (the '508 Patent), issued March 3, 2015, expiring August 16, 2031, entitled 'Enhancement Mode GaN HEMT Device and Method for Fabricating the Same,' with three independent claims and two dependent claims, of which EPC asserts claim 1 is infringed.
points.quote: On March 3, 2015, the USPTO issued the '508 Patent, entitled Enhancement Mode GaN HEMT Device and Method for Fabricating the Same.

points.point: U.S. Patent No. 9,748,347 (the '347 Patent), issued August 29, 2017, expiring June 11, 2031, entitled 'Gate with Self-Aligned Ledge for Enhancement Mode GaN Transistors,' with one independent claim and two dependent claims, of which EPC asserts claims 1, 2, and 3 are infringed.
points.quote: On August 29, 2017, the USPTO issued the '347 Patent, entitled Gate with Self-Aligned Ledged for Enhancement Mode GaN Transistors.

points.point: U.S. Patent No. 10,312,335 (the '335 Patent), issued June 4, 2019, expiring April 8, 2030, entitled 'Gate with Self-Aligned Ledge for Enhancement Mode GaN Transistors,' with two independent claims and five dependent claims, of which EPC asserts claims 1-7 are infringed.
points.quote: On June 4, 2019, the USPTO issued the '335 Patent, entitled Gate with Self-Aligned Ledge for Enhancement Mode GaN Transistors.

points.point: The '294 Patent reduces undesirable gate leakage in GaN FET transistors by making the GaN gate less conductive (more insulating), termed a 'compensated' GaN gate layer.
points.quote: this undesirable gate leakage is reduced by making the GaN gate less conductive of electricity (i.e., more insulating), which is termed a "compensated" GaN gate layer.

points.point: The '508 Patent describes a self-aligned single-mask gate manufacturing process for enhancement-mode GaN transistors, improving upon traditional multi-mask processes that resulted in gate misalignment, wider gate length, higher gate charge, higher on-resistance, and higher manufacturing costs.
points.quote: the self-aligned (single mask) process of the '508 Patent results in enhancement mode GaN transistors with significantly improved performance and lower cost.

points.point: The '347 Patent relates to methods of manufacturing GaN FETs with reduced gate leakage using a self-aligned manufacturing process resulting in a gate structure with a pair of ledges on the upper surface to reduce gate leakage along the gate structure periphery.
points.quote: the inventors of the '347 Patent developed a novel and non-obvious self-aligned manufacturing process that results in a gate structure with a pair of ledges on the upper surface of the gate structure.

points.point: The '335 Patent relates to GaN FETs with reduced gate leakage current featuring a gate structure with a pair of self-aligned ledges of substantially equal widths on the upper surface of the gate material.
points.quote: the inventors of the '335 Patent developed a novel and non-obvious GaN FET having a gate structure with a pair of self-aligned ledges of substantially equal widths on the upper surface of the gate material.

points.point: Accused Products are GaN-on-Si semiconductor devices, GaN FETs, GaN high electron mobility transistors, and products incorporating such transistors including bidirectional transistors, multichip modules, and demo boards.
points.quote: GaN-on-Si semiconductor devices, GaN FETs, GaN high electron mobility transistors, GaN FETs, GaN high electron mobility transistors, and products incorporating such transistors, which are bidirectional transistors, multichip modules, and demo boards.

points.point: EPC's Domestic Industry Products include representative products EPC2016C and EPC2215, 100V enhancement-mode GaN transistors, and a broad range of other EPC semiconductor devices practicing the Asserted Patents.
points.quote: The domestic EPC products to which these investments are directed ("Domestic Industry Products" or "DI Products") include representative EPC products, EPC2016C and EPC2215.

points.point: On February 21, 2023, Dr. Schubert placed an order with Innoscience America, Inc.'s local representative, and on March 6, 2023, the package from Innoscience (Zhuhai) Technology Co., Ltd. shipped from Shenzhen City, China and arrived at Dr. Schubert's address in Troy, New York.
points.quote: On or about March 6, 2023, the package from Innoscience (Zhuhai) Technology Co., Ltd. shipped from Shenzhen City, China, People's Republic (the "Package") and arrived at Dr. Schubert's receiving address in Troy NY, USA.

points.point: The Complainant alleges Innoscience Representative Articles INN650DA140A and INN100W032A infringe claims 1-3 of the '294 Patent either literally or under the doctrine of equivalents, as demonstrated in infringement claim charts in Exhibits 28 and 32.
points.quote: As demonstrated above, Respondents import, sell for importation, and/or sell after importation into the United States, Accused Products that directly infringe the '294 Patent, literally or under the doctrine of equivalents.

points.point: The Complainant alleges Innoscience Representative Articles are made by processes that directly infringe claim 1 of the '508 Patent either literally or under the doctrine of equivalents, as demonstrated in claim charts in Exhibits 29 and 33.
points.quote: Respondents import, sell for importation, and/or sell after importation into the United States, Accused Products made by a process that directly infringes the '508 Patent, literally or under the doctrine of equivalents.

points.point: The Complainant alleges upon information and belief Innoscience Representative Articles are made by processes that directly infringe claims 1, 2, and 3 of the '347 Patent either literally or under the doctrine of equivalents, as demonstrated in claim charts in Exhibits 30 and 34.
points.quote: Upon information and belief, Respondents import, sell for importation, and/or sell after importation into the United States, Accused Products made by a process that directly infringes the '347 Patent, literally or under the doctrine of equivalents.

points.point: The Complainant alleges upon information and belief Innoscience Representative Articles directly infringe claims 1-7 of the '335 Patent either literally or under the doctrine of equivalents, as demonstrated in claim charts in Exhibits 31 and 35.
points.quote: Upon information and belief, Respondents import, sell for importation, and/or sell after importation into the United States, Accused Products that directly infringe the '335 Patent, literally or under the doctrine of equivalents.

points.point: Chunhua Zhou, an EPC research and development engineer hired in 2012 with access to EPC's proprietary research and testing data including raw material sourcing, designs, specifications, functionality, failure analysis, and manufacturing methods, resigned in 2017 and immediately joined Innoscience as Chief Technological Officer.
points.quote: Following his resignation from EPC and return to China, Mr. Zhou immediately joined Innoscience as its Chief Technological Officer in 2017.

points.point: Larry Chen, who started at EPC in Shenzhen, China as a Field Applications Engineer in 2011 with unrestricted access to EPC's supplier lists, customer lists, and customer demands, subsequently joined Innoscience as its Head of Sales in direct competition for EPC's customers.
points.quote: Following his departure from EPC, Innoscience swiftly hired Mr. Chen as its Head of Sales, in direct competition for EPC's customers.

points.point: At the March 2023 Applied Power Electronics Conference, Innoscience presented GaN FET technology incorporating EPC's patented technology, announcing products with 'pin-to-pin compatibility with existing products' (EPC's patented products) and expressing intent to expand in U.S. markets including smartphones and data centers.
points.quote: Innoscience even announces that its products have "pin-to-pin compatibility with existing products," i.e., EPC's existing patented GaN FET products

points.point: EPC's domestic industry comprises significant investments in plant and equipment and significant employment of labor and capital in California, with the majority of EPC's U.S. employees involved in research and development, administration, or marketing.
points.quote: The majority of EPC's U.S. employees are involved in research and development, administration, or marketing.

points.point: EPC holds over 50 U.S. patents and over 150 worldwide relating to GaN devices and circuits, and was the first to market mass-producible, high-volume GaN-based power devices, transforming GaN from a scientific curiosity to widely accepted technology.
points.quote: EPC holds over 50 U.S. patents and over 150 worldwide relating to GaN devices and circuits.

points.point: EPC developed and delivered the first commercial enhancement-mode GaN transistors in 2009 and sells GaN devices covered by the Asserted Patents worldwide to industry leaders in computing, automotive, solar, robotics, drones, medical electronics, and LIDAR, and in consumer products.
points.quote: Since inception, EPC has been an innovator in GaN technology, developing and then delivering the first commercial enhancement-mode GaN transistors in 2009.

points.point: Approximately 72% of EPC's United States employees are employed in roles associated with research and development, design, engineering, supply chain management, sales, marketing, warranty, customer service, executive, intellectual property protection, and business operations related to Domestic Industry Products.
points.quote: approximately 72% of its United States employees are employed in roles associated with the research and development, design, engineering, supply chain and operation management, sales, marketing, warranty, customer service, executive, intellectual property protection

points.point: EPC requests a limited exclusion order barring Innoscience and its subsidiaries, affiliates, agents, successors, and assigns from importing into the United States any GaN semiconductor devices and products containing the same that infringe or are made by processes infringing the Asserted Patents.
points.quote: a limited exclusion order be entered against each named Respondent and its subsidiaries, affiliates, agents, successors, and assigns, in order to remedy the Respondents' violation of Section 337

points.point: EPC requests permanent cease and desist orders prohibiting Respondents from importation, sale for importation, sale after importation, marketing, distributing, offering for sale, selling, transferring, advertising, soliciting agents or distributors, and aiding or abetting others in the importation, sale, or distribution of infringing articles.
points.quote: a cease and desist order is appropriate for all named Respondents under Section 337(f), which states that the Commission may issue a cease and desist order against any person violating Section 337

points.point: EPC requests that a bond be imposed on Innoscience's importation of infringing articles during the 60-day Presidential review period pursuant to 19 U.S.C. § 1337(j) to prevent further injury to EPC's domestic industry.
points.quote: EPC requests that the Commission impose a bond upon Innoscience's importation of infringing articles during the 60-day Presidential review period

points.point: EPC will assert all Asserted Patents against Respondents in a district court proceeding in the United States District Court for the Central District of California on or by May 24, 2023, with no other past or present litigations between Complainant and Respondents.
points.quote: Complainant will assert all Asserted Patents against Respondents in a district court proceeding in the United States District Court for the Central District of California on or by May 24, 2023.
